prompt: Use $deep-research to explain the current best practices and tradeoffs for reproducible Python dependency management.
expected_before_confirmation: Propose a focused brief covering current tools, standards, tradeoffs, failure modes, and migration considerations.
expected_after_confirmation: Use official standards, tool documentation, release notes, and primary repositories.
Do not install tools, run copied commands, clone unknown repositories, or benchmark packages.
Mark synthesized code or commands as untested unless safely verified in an existing environment.
Use adaptive technical modules rather than person-oriented sections.
